cases.stdout:
Ottrin — find, inspect, and manage files

Usage:
  ottrin portal                   Run the desktop file-dialog backend
  ottrin picker                   Open an Ottrin chooser using a JSON stdin request
    --cancel-on-disconnect        Read one JSON line and cancel when the caller closes stdin
  ottrin                         Open the file manager
  ottrin <FILE>                  Open the file directly in Quick Inspector
  ottrin <DIRECTORY>             Open the file manager in that directory
  ottrin --select <FILE>         Open the parent folder with the file selected
  ottrin search <QUERY> [--json] Search indexed files (-s)
                       [--content] Also search the configured content folders
                       [--limit N] [--offset N] Select a result page
  ottrin index [update] [--json]
                                 Update the configured search index
  ottrin index ensure            Start this package's user index and wait for readiness
  ottrin index status [--json]   Show persisted index status without starting it
  ottrin index rebuild [--json]
                                 Build and atomically publish a fresh index
  ottrin preview <FILE>          Open the full Quick Inspector (-p)
  ottrin drop status             Show Drop Folder state
  ottrin drop copy <PATH>…       Copy paths into the Drop Folder

Options (GUI options may appear before or after the file/directory target):
  --renderer opengl  Recovery override for a compatible OpenGL driver
  --helper-path PATH Developer override for privileged helper discovery
  --uninstall        Remove Ottrin background jobs and generated data
  --purge-config     With --uninstall, also remove saved preferences
Use -- before a literal option-like target or search query.
